name: cg_defi_global
description:
Decentralised-finance market statistics from CoinGecko (global/decentralized_finance_defi).
Returns {data: {defi_market_cap, eth_market_cap, defi_to_eth_ratio, trading_volume_24h, defi_dominance, top_coin_name, top_coin_defi_dominance}}; values are strings as CoinGecko sends them.
Inputs: none.
For the whole crypto market use cg_market_global.
Example: {}
